answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the tide of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jade re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the ferrous of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work.
